radioGroup.value: Controlled value of the selected RadioGroupItem.
radioGroup.defaultValue: Initial value for an uncontrolled group.
radioGroup.onValueChange: Called when the selected value changes.
radioGroup.name: Shared field name used when the group is submitted in a form.
radioGroup.disabledGroup: Disables every radio in the group.
radioGroup.selectedIndex: Compatibility API for enhanced RadioItem rows.
radioGroup.itemValue: Unique value represented by the radio control.
radioGroup.itemDisabled: Prevents the item from being selected.
radioGroup.required: Marks the control as required for form validation.
radioGroup.readOnly: Keeps the current value while preventing selection changes.
radioGroup.label: Text label for the enhanced row.
radioGroup.onSelect: Called when the row is selected.
radioGroup.enhancedValue: Optional value for controlled value mode.
